title: About me
about: Hi! I'm Wout, a third-year student of Multimedia and Creative Technology at Erasmus University College Brussels, with a strong passion for front-end development and motion design. I enjoy experimenting with new technologies and challenge myself to work creatively and solution-oriented. In addition to my studies, I am active as a social media manager at JNM (Youth Association for Nature and Environment), where I work on promotional material such as Instagram content, flyers, and magazines. In my spare time, I like to focus on honing my technical and visual skills.
